name: Index Opening-Candle Drive
hypothesis: The first cash-session M15 candle direction of NAS100/US500/GER40 persists through the session (opening-range momentum, adapted to 15 minutes).
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop at the opening candle opposite extreme; 6R objective; flat 15 minutes before the cash close; dojis (body <25% of range) skipped.
planned_rr: 6R fixed target (most exits expected at the session time limit)
known_limitations: No verified edge. M15 both-barrier candles need M1 (only since Jul 2026) and are otherwise AMBIGUOUS; CFD spread proxies; correlated instruments; broker holiday calendar unverified. Correlated with index_trend_day (same instruments and sessions).

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
